g.text: China adds the most; India and Africa grow faster
Compare both the size of the increase and its growth rate. These regions do not overlap.
Source: IEA WEO 2025, Table A.16 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); calculations. Stated-policies scenario only.
World electricity demand rises from 27,290 to 49,657 TWh/year. The chart uses demand, not generation.
